presets.label: Classic Sci Fi Robot
presets.blurb: A flat buzzing monotone with a metal ring in its chest, the robot of old science fiction films.

presets.label: Giant Mech
presets.blurb: A two storey war machine: deep and grinding, a low mechanical hum under every word, booming off the hangar walls.

presets.label: Tiny Drone
presets.blurb: A palm sized flying robot: squeaky, metallic and buzzing like little propellers.

presets.label: Old Speech Synthesizer
presets.blurb: A 1980s text to speech box: dead flat pitch, gritty low rate samples and a small speaker.

presets.label: Calm Assistant AI
presets.blurb: A smooth, polite computer voice: still clearly human, but levelled, tuned and polished.

presets.label: Factory Robot
presets.blurb: A heavy industrial machine voice: a low distorted buzz with steel resonance, echoing around a factory floor.

presets.label: Half Human Cyborg
presets.blurb: A person with machine parts: the real voice is there, half of it flattened and tuned, with a thin metallic shimmer.

presets.label: Broken Android
presets.blurb: A synthetic person glitching out: flat tuned speech that stutters, jumps in pitch and drops out.

presets.label: Steampunk Automaton
presets.blurb: A brass and valve gentleman machine: clockwork reeds in whole tone steps, warm valve grit and a springy brass horn.

presets.label: Villain AI
presets.blurb: A cold computer that has decided it knows best: lower, flattened, with a minor chord synth speaking along in a cold space.

presets.label: Robot on the Radio
presets.blurb: A buzzing robot voice coming over a crunchy, narrow two way radio.

presets.label: Cute Toy Robot
presets.blurb: A friendly little toy robot: a small high buzzing voice from a tiny plastic speaker.

presets.label: Old Mainframe Computer
presets.blurb: A room sized computer reading out its results: a square wave synth speaking the words, crushed and pulsing.

presets.label: Security Droid
presets.blurb: A patrol robot on a loudspeaker: flat, stern and honky, every word snapped to an exact note.

presets.label: Robot Running Out of Battery
presets.blurb: A robot whose power is failing: the buzz sags and wobbles down at the end of every phrase.

presets.label: Synthesizer Android
presets.blurb: A synth played through a robot's mouth, following the rise and fall of your voice like a talk box.

presets.label: Deep Space Probe
presets.blurb: A lonely probe transmitting from far away: the words as whistling sine tones with a faint ring and echo.

presets.label: Nanobot Swarm
presets.blurb: Millions of tiny machines speaking together: a metallic buzzing swarm in the shape of the words.
